questions.q: What is an Assignment Group, in real implementation terms?
options: A field that stores only the single agent assigned to a ticket
A queue of agents (sys_user_group) that an incident is routed to before individual pickup
A report that lists all open incidents
A choice list value for Impact
questions.explain: Assignment Group is a group record that a set of agents belong to, used as a routing queue.

questions.q: What is the legacy table-backed mechanism for automatically setting Assignment Group on incident creation?
options: priority_lookup_rule
major_incident_state
sys_choice
sysrule_assignment (Assignment Rules)
questions.explain: sysrule_assignment is the legacy Assignment Rule mechanism: a condition mapped to a target group or agent.

questions.q: What is the modern alternative to a plain Assignment Rule for routing a new incident?
options: Manually reassigning every incident after creation
Deleting the Assignment Group field entirely
A Flow Designer flow with an Incident Created trigger that sets Assignment Group as one action in a larger sequence
A Data Policy that blocks incident creation
questions.explain: A Flow Designer flow can set Assignment Group and also notify the group, log the decision, or call an integration — all in one auditable sequence.

questions.q: Why might Category alone not be enough to route an incident correctly?
options: Category is sometimes too broad; Configuration Item or caller location can be needed to route correctly
Category is not a real field on the incident table
Only Priority can be used for routing, never Category
Category changes automatically every time an incident is updated
questions.explain: Configuration Item narrows routing to the specific affected service, and caller location matters for regional support teams.

questions.q: Why do real implementations use round robin or load balancing instead of hard-coding Assigned To in the rule or flow?
options: Hard-coding Assigned To is actually required by ServiceNow
Round robin and load balancing distribute work within the group instead of overloading one agent
Round robin only works for Assignment Groups with one member
Load balancing disables the Assignment Group field
questions.explain: Setting assigned_to directly every time tends to overload whichever agent is listed first; rotation or current-load balancing spreads the work.
